rationale: C07 plausibly supplied a concrete operative template: an invitation to citizens to participate in a commemorative observance followed by a separate request to governors to promote participation. The child adapts that same two-part participation machinery, expanding the requested officials and organizations and adding cooperation with a presidential committee. C03 is also structurally close because it separately urges public officials and enumerated civic organizations to arrange observances, while C13 parallels cooperation with a named organizing body, but neither matches the child's invitation-plus-governors sequence as closely as C07.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do call upon the people of our Nation to observe the week ... and to cooperate with the President's Committee
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby invite American citizens from every region of our country to come to their Nation's Capital and participate in the sesquicentennial observances
shared_material.explanation: Both first address the public and call for participation in a designated commemorative observance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I also request the Governors of States ... to participate actively in this observance.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I also request the Governors of the respective States, Territories and possessions of the United States to issue proclamations urging participation in these celebrations.
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive follow-on request beginning 'I also request the Governors' and directed toward promoting participation is closely parallel, with the child broadening the addressees and modifying their role.
